MATHEMATICS 9709/12
Paper 1 Pure Mathematics 1 May/June 2023
1 hour 50 minutes
You must answer on the question paper.
You will need: List of formulae (MF19)
INSTRUCTIONS
/solidcircle Answer all questions.
/solidcircle Use a black or dark blue pen. You may use an HB pencil for any diagrams or graphs.
/solidcircle Write your name, centre number and candidate number in the boxes at the top of the page.
/solidcircle Write your answer to each question in the space provided.
/solidcircle Do not use an erasable pen or correction fluid.
/solidcircle Do not write on any bar codes.
/solidcircle If additional space is needed, you should use the lined page at the end of this booklet; the question
number or numbers must be clearly shown.
/solidcircle You should use a calculator where appropriate.
/solidcircle You must show all necessary working clearly; no marks will begiven for unsupported answers from a
calculator.
/solidcircle Give non-exact numerical answers correct to 3 significant figures, or 1 decimal place for angles in
degrees, unless a different level of accuracy is specified in the question.
INFORMATION
/solidcircle The total mark for this paper is 75.
/solidcircle The number of marks for each question or part question is shown in brackets [ ].
